actual_validation.method: Using repository .venv/bin/python -B, import scripts/run_jevbench_public.py and call load_public(current_checkout) with unchanged configs/benchmarks/jevbench-public.json. This imports verified official bytes, loads all three original JSONL files in declared order, verifies per-file source/data hashes, exact full count and unique IDs, public-only split, canonical dataset hash, and ordered-ID hash. Count types, source groups, missing expected values and exclude_reason on loaded Task objects.
actual_validation.scope: Source and dataset validation, not model inference or a new benchmark score.

current_checkout_scope: Independent filtered clone with detached HEAD; legacy checkout and config not modified.

current_official_website_assessment.availability_assessment: The inspected current official benchmark repository exposes the same 231 typed public cases. No downloadable release-draw P300 task population was located in the inspected repository or the official data-card, manifest and Hugging Face result links.
current_official_website_assessment.data_download_scope: Official data card and Hugging Face dataset distribute system-level aggregate measurements; they do not provide the current release-draw public task inputs or sealed inputs.
current_official_website_assessment.headline_scoring_scope: Current official Capability/Composite require versioned official populations, calibration/serving/cost evidence and admission. The public score_task screening does not produce those official axes or a leaderboard rank.
current_official_website_assessment.report_label: Current-repository legacy public231 screening; not the P300+S1200 release draw.
current_official_website_assessment.separate_benchmark: JevBench/JevBench metamorphic coherence mini must be scored and reported separately.

historical_archive_integrity_observation.scope: This turn independently re-read the existing historical ZIP; integrity validation only, not a new official scoring pass.

public_population.ordered_inventory_encoding: UTF-8 JSON array of {index,id,type,labels,expected}; ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon). Only digest retained here.

separate_image_box_track.scope: New image bounding-box track is separate from typed text and ImageJevBench core; it cannot be merged to fill the text P300 population.
